# CONV-19 libs/ingest — resource scan / well tops / well location XML /
# preview parse cores ported from paleo_workbench.resources (Qt-free,
# Python-free). Frozen against the Python oracle generated by
# oracle/generate_ingest_oracles.py.
add_library(pwb_ingest STATIC
    src/py_compat.cpp
    src/xml_scanner.cpp
    src/well_tops.cpp
    src/well_xml.cpp
    src/classifier.cpp
    src/project_path.cpp
    src/preview/models.cpp
    src/preview/text_parsers.cpp
    src/preview/document_parsers.cpp
    src/preview/spreadsheetml.cpp
    src/preview/well_log_xml_preview.cpp
    src/preview/office.cpp
    src/preview/las_preview.cpp
    src/preview/registry.cpp)
add_library(Pwb::Ingest ALIAS pwb_ingest)
target_include_directories(pwb_ingest PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>)
target_compile_features(pwb_ingest PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
# Pwb::Domain provides nlohmann JSON + SHA-256 (same vendored dependency the
# data kernel uses; no new third-party code).
target_link_libraries(pwb_ingest PUBLIC Pwb::Domain)

# BEGIN VIZ-A: WLE-backed LAS preview bridge. Only when the SDK participates
# in the build (science_suite adds well-log-engine before this directory —
# or the root VIZ-A block re-enters this directory in VIZ_A_LATE_BRIDGE
# mode when data_suite pulled ingest in before the SDK existed); without it
# the registry LAS branch reports capability-unavailable.
if(VIZ_A_LATE_BRIDGE)
    # Bridge-only re-entry (see root CMakeLists VIZ-A block): everything
    # else above already exists; do not redefine it.
    if(NOT TARGET WellLog::IO)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "VIZ-A late bridge requires WellLog::IO")
    endif()
    add_library(pwb_ingest_las_wle STATIC
        src/preview/las_wle_bridge.cpp)
    add_library(Pwb::IngestLasWle ALIAS pwb_ingest_las_wle)
    target_include_directories(pwb_ingest_las_wle PUBLIC
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>)
    target_compile_features(pwb_ingest_las_wle PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
    target_link_libraries(pwb_ingest_las_wle
        PUBLIC pwb_ingest
        PRIVATE WellLog::IO)
    return()
endif()

if(TARGET WellLog::IO)
    add_library(pwb_ingest_las_wle STATIC
        src/preview/las_wle_bridge.cpp)
    add_library(Pwb::IngestLasWle ALIAS pwb_ingest_las_wle)
    target_include_directories(pwb_ingest_las_wle PUBLIC
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>)
    target_compile_features(pwb_ingest_las_wle PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
    target_link_libraries(pwb_ingest_las_wle
        PUBLIC Pwb::Ingest
        PRIVATE WellLog::IO)
    target_compile_definitions(pwb_ingest_las_wle PRIVATE
        PWB_INGEST_HAVE_WLE_LAS=1)
endif()
# END VIZ-A

if(BUILD_TESTING)
    add_subdirectory(ingest_tests)
endif()
